words.enDefinition: a bag with two straps worn on your back

examples.en: My backpack is so heavy that my shoulders hurt after Monday classes.
examples.zh: 「双肩背包」太沉了，周一上完课肩膀都疼。

examples.en: I always keep a charger and an umbrella in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我总是在「背包」里备着充电器和雨伞。

words.enDefinition: a padded case that protects a laptop inside another bag

examples.en: My laptop sleeve has extra padding, so I never worry about bumps.
examples.zh: 我的「电脑内胆包」有加厚夹层，从不担心磕碰。

examples.en: Slide the laptop sleeve into your backpack before heading to the library.
examples.zh: 去图书馆前，先把「电脑内胆包」塞进背包里。

words.enDefinition: a padded bag designed to carry a laptop and accessories

examples.en: He bought a laptop bag with a shoulder strap for commute days.
examples.zh: 他买了个带肩带的「笔记本电脑包」，通勤时用。

examples.en: The laptop bag's front pocket fits my chargers and sticky notes.
examples.zh: 「电脑包」的前袋装得下充电器和便利贴。

collocations: laptop bag with a shoulder strap

words.enDefinition: a large open bag with two parallel handles

examples.en: I carry my tote bag to seminars instead of my heavy backpack.
examples.zh: 上研讨课我背「托特包」，不背沉重的双肩包。

examples.en: This canvas tote bag from the campus bookstore holds all my textbooks.
examples.zh: 校园书店买的这款「托特包」能装下我全部课本。

words.enDefinition: a soft bag closed by pulling a string at the top

examples.en: I keep a drawstring bag in my locker for gym sessions.
examples.zh: 我在储物柜里放了个「束口袋」，体育课用。

examples.en: The drawstring bag cinches tight, so nothing falls out while I bike.
examples.zh: 「束口袋」一拉收紧，骑车时东西不会掉出来。

words.enDefinition: a large cylindrical bag for sports gear or short trips

examples.en: My roommate packed her duffel bag for the weekend trip home.
examples.zh: 室友收拾好了「圆筒旅行包」，周末回家用。

examples.en: The gym requires a locker, so I leave my duffel bag there.
examples.zh: 健身房要求用储物柜，所以我把「旅行包」存在那里。

words.enDefinition: a small bag worn across the body on a long strap

examples.en: She wears a crossbody bag so her wallet stays safe on the bus.
examples.zh: 她斜挎着「斜挎包」，坐公交时钱包更安全。

examples.en: A crossbody bag is handy for quick runs to the dining hall.
examples.zh: 去食堂快取快走，带个「斜挎包」正合适。

words.enDefinition: a small pouch worn around the waist

examples.en: Tourists and students alike wear a fanny pack for crowded campus events.
examples.zh: 校园活动人挤人，游客学生都爱戴「腰包」。

examples.en: My fanny pack holds my keycard, cash, and lip balm.
examples.zh: 我的「腰包」装着门卡、现金和润唇膏。

words.enDefinition: a durable shopping bag used instead of disposable plastic ones

examples.en: Many grocery stores here charge for plastic bags, so I bring a reusable bag.
examples.zh: 这边超市对塑料袋收费，所以我自带「环保购物袋」。

examples.en: Keep a reusable bag folded in your backpack for unexpected errands.
examples.zh: 在背包里常备一个折叠的「环保袋」，临时买东西用得上。

words.enDefinition: a bag used to carry food and shopping home

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted a grocery bag for the apples.
examples.zh: 收银员问苹果要不要装「购物袋」。

examples.en: We collect grocery bags under the sink to line the small trash can.
examples.zh: 我们把「购物袋」攒在水槽下面，用来套小垃圾桶。

collocations: stuff grocery bags in a drawer

words.enDefinition: an insulated bag that keeps packed lunches fresh

examples.en: My insulated lunch bag keeps my meal cold until noon.
examples.zh: 我的「午餐保温包」能让饭菜到中午还是凉的。

examples.en: Don't forget your lunch bag in the shared lab fridge overnight.
examples.zh: 别把「午餐包」忘在实验室公用冰箱里过夜。

words.enDefinition: a label attached to luggage showing owner contact details

examples.en: Attach a luggage tag before checking your suitcase at the airport.
examples.zh: 机场托运行李前，先挂好「行李牌」。

examples.en: My luggage tag shows my school email, not my home address.
examples.zh: 我的「行李牌」上写的是学校邮箱，不是家庭住址。

words.enDefinition: small papers with reusable adhesive for quick reminders

examples.en: I stick sticky notes on my monitor to remember homework deadlines.
examples.zh: 我把「便利贴」贴在显示器上，提醒自己作业截止日期。

examples.en: She left sticky notes on shared dishes asking roommates to wash them.
examples.zh: 她在公用碗盘上贴「便利贴」，请室友自己洗。

words.enDefinition: a small pad of paper for jotting quick notes

examples.en: Keep a notepad by the phone to jot down package pickup codes.
examples.zh: 在电话旁放个「便签本」，随手记包裹取件码。

examples.en: The TA handed each student a small notepad during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周时助教给每个学生发了个小「便签本」。

collocations: flip to a fresh notepad page

words.enDefinition: a notebook whose pages are held by a wire coil

examples.en: I fill one spiral notebook per course to keep my notes organized.
examples.zh: 我每门课用一本「线圈笔记本」，笔记好整理。

examples.en: The spiral notebook's cover is jammed with handouts from this semester.
examples.zh: 这本「线圈本」封皮里塞满了这学期的讲义。

collocations: tear a page from a spiral notebook

words.enDefinition: a folder with metal rings that holds loose-leaf papers

examples.en: My biology binder has tab dividers for lecture notes and lab reports.
examples.zh: 我的生物「活页夹」用分页标签隔开课堂笔记和实验报告。

examples.en: The binder rings snapped shut before the syllabus slipped out.
examples.zh: 「活页夹」的环扣一合上，课程大纲就掉不出来了。

words.enDefinition: a light cardboard cover for organizing loose papers

examples.en: I keep a blue folder for printed readings I haven't annotated yet.
examples.zh: 我用一个蓝色「文件夹」装还没标注的打印阅读材料。

examples.en: Hand in your essay in a folder with your name on the tab.
examples.zh: 交论文时装进「文件夹」，标签处写上名字。

words.enDefinition: a paper folder with tabs for organizing documents

examples.en: The advisor keeps every student's records in a separate file folder.
examples.zh: 导师把每个学生的资料分放在单独的「档案文件夹」里。

examples.en: Label each file folder clearly so the drawer stays organized.
examples.zh: 每个「档案夹」都贴好标签，抽屉才能保持整齐。

words.enDefinition: a small stiff card used for notes and flashcards

examples.en: I write vocabulary on index cards to quiz myself on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把生词写在「索引卡」上，坐公交时自测。

examples.en: One index card per term works better than a crowded sheet.
examples.zh: 一个术语一张「索引卡」，比挤在一页上效果好。

words.enDefinition: a hard board with a clip that holds papers while writing

examples.en: The club recruiter carried a clipboard to collect email sign-ups on the quad.
examples.zh: 社团招新的人在草坪上拿「写字板」收集报名邮箱。

examples.en: For lab safety training, sign the form on this clipboard.
examples.zh: 实验室安全培训的表格，请在这块「带夹写字板」上签。

words.enDefinition: a marker with bright ink used to emphasize text

examples.en: Use a yellow highlighter sparingly, or the whole page glows.
examples.zh: 黄色「荧光笔」要少用，不然整页都在发光。

examples.en: She color-codes her highlighters: pink for terms, green for examples.
examples.zh: 她的「荧光笔」分色使用：粉色标术语，绿色标例句。

words.enDefinition: a marker whose ink does not wash off easily

examples.en: Label your meal containers with a permanent marker so no one takes them.
examples.zh: 用「油性记号笔」给饭盒写名字，免得被人拿走。

examples.en: A permanent marker wrote our dorm room number on the moving boxes.
examples.zh: 我们用「记号笔」把宿舍房间号写在搬家纸箱上。

words.enDefinition: a marker whose ink wipes off whiteboards easily

examples.en: The whiteboard marker had dried out, so I grabbed a spare from the tray.
examples.zh: 那支「白板笔」干了，我从笔托里拿了支备用的。

examples.en: Borrow my roommate's whiteboard marker for tonight's group study session.
examples.zh: 今晚小组学习，先跟室友借好「白板笔」。

words.enDefinition: a pencil with replaceable lead that needs no sharpening

examples.en: I always carry a mechanical pencil with extra lead for exams.
examples.zh: 考试时我总带着「自动铅笔」和备用铅芯。

examples.en: Scantron forms require pencil, so my mechanical pencil gets heavy use.
examples.zh: 答题卡要用铅笔填涂，我的「自动铅笔」使用率超高。

words.enDefinition: a pen that writes with smooth, thick gel ink

examples.en: My gel pen skips on glossy paper, so I use a ballpoint for handouts.
examples.zh: 我的「中性笔」在铜版纸上断墨，打印讲义我改用圆珠笔。

examples.en: She bought a pastel gel pen set for annotating her planner.
examples.zh: 她买了一组浅色「中性笔」，用来给手账做批注。

words.enDefinition: a small bag or box for holding pens and pencils

examples.en: My pencil case has three compartments: pens, highlighters, and erasers.
examples.zh: 我的「笔袋」有三个隔层：笔、荧光笔和橡皮。

examples.en: Zip your pencil case closed before tossing it into your backpack.
examples.zh: 把「笔袋」拉链拉好，再塞进背包。

words.enDefinition: a small device that sharpens pencil tips

examples.en: The classroom pencil sharpener jammed twice during the morning quiz.
examples.zh: 早上的随堂测验里，教室的「卷笔刀」卡了两次。

examples.en: I keep a tiny pencil sharpener in my pencil case for wooden pencils.
examples.zh: 我的笔袋里放着小「卷笔刀」，削木头铅笔用。

words.enDefinition: a small rubber block that removes pencil marks

examples.en: My desk mate lent me an eraser when mine went missing.
examples.zh: 我的「橡皮」不见了，同桌借了我一块。

examples.en: Kneaded erasers pick up graphite marks without leaving crumbs behind.
examples.zh: 可塑「橡皮」能粘走石墨痕迹，还不掉碎屑。

words.enDefinition: a small device that performs mathematical calculations

examples.en: The stats professor allows a scientific calculator but no phones during exams.
examples.zh: 统计课教授允许用「科学计算器」，但考试不许用手机。

examples.en: I forgot my calculator, so my neighbor shared theirs during the drill.
examples.zh: 我忘带「计算器」了，做练习时邻座跟我共用。

words.enDefinition: a device that fastens papers together with metal staples

examples.en: Ask the front desk for the stapler before you hand in your report.
examples.zh: 交报告前，先去前台借「订书机」。

examples.en: Our group's stapler ran out of staples right before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止日期前，我们小组的「订书机」偏偏没钉书钉了。

words.enDefinition: a cutting tool with two blades and finger holes

examples.en: Craft scissors for poster-making live in the student council supply drawer.
examples.zh: 做海报的工艺「剪刀」放在学生会用品抽屉里。

examples.en: Please return the scissors to the art room after cutting the felt.
examples.zh: 剪完毛毡，请把「剪刀」归还美术教室。

words.enDefinition: a small metal loop that holds loose papers together

examples.en: Use a paper clip to attach your receipt to the reimbursement form.
examples.zh: 用「回形针」把收据别在报销单上。

examples.en: The essay pages kept sliding, so a paper clip held them together.
examples.zh: 论文页总滑落，就用「回形针」别在一起。

collocations: clip papers with a paper clip

words.enDefinition: a strong metal clip that grips thick stacks of paper

examples.en: A binder clip keeps my thick lab manual from falling apart.
examples.zh: 一个「长尾夹」让厚厚的实验手册不散架。

examples.en: Use binder clips to seal the chip bag instead of folding it.
examples.zh: 找不到封口夹就用「长尾夹」夹住薯片袋，别折它。

collocations: binder clip on a chip bag

words.enDefinition: a small dispenser that covers writing mistakes with tape

examples.en: Correction tape works better than liquid for neat handwritten edits.
examples.zh: 改手写稿，「修正带」比修正液更整洁。

examples.en: I ran out of correction tape halfway through the application form.
examples.zh: 申请表填到一半，「修正带」就用完了。

words.enDefinition: a twist-up tube of solid adhesive for paper crafts

examples.en: A glue stick holds photo corners flat without wrinkling the page.
examples.zh: 「固体胶」能把照片角粘平，纸面不起皱。

examples.en: For the poster project, one glue stick per group is enough.
examples.zh: 做海报项目，每组一支「固体胶」就够了。

words.enDefinition: a device that supplies power to recharge a battery

examples.en: Can I borrow your laptop charger since mine is still in the dorm?
examples.zh: 能借你的「电脑充电器」吗？我的还落在宿舍。

examples.en: Public library desks now have a built-in charger and USB ports.
examples.zh: 公共图书馆的座位现在自带「充电器」和USB接口。

words.enDefinition: a portable battery that charges phones on the go

examples.en: My power bank died halfway through the campus tour, of all days.
examples.zh: 偏偏在校园参观那天，我的「充电宝」半路没电了。

examples.en: Airline rules let you carry a power bank in cabin luggage only.
examples.zh: 按航空规定，「充电宝」只能随身携带，不能托运。

words.enDefinition: a cord that connects a device to its charger

examples.en: A frayed charging cable is a fire risk, so replace it right away.
examples.zh: 破损的「充电线」有起火风险，要立刻换掉。

examples.en: I label my charging cable with washi tape so no one mistakes it.
examples.zh: 我用和纸胶带给「充电线」做标记，免得拿混。

words.enDefinition: a plug that fits foreign outlets for your devices

examples.en: Buy a travel adapter before flying home, or your laptop won't charge.
examples.zh: 回国前买好「旅行转换插头」，不然笔记本没法充电。

examples.en: This travel adapter covers European outlets, including the UK's chunky three-pin type.
examples.zh: 这个「转换插头」适配欧洲各国插座，包括英国那种粗三脚款。

words.enDefinition: a block with several outlets expanding a single socket

examples.en: The dorm only allows a power strip with a surge breaker.
examples.zh: 宿舍只允许用带过载保护的「插线板」。

examples.en: Plug the mini fridge and kettle into separate power strips, not one.
examples.zh: 小冰箱和热水壶各插一个「电源插排」，别共用一个。

words.enDefinition: a power strip that shields devices from voltage spikes

examples.en: A surge protector shields your laptop during summer thunderstorm season.
examples.zh: 夏天雷雨多，「防浪涌插座」能保护你的笔记本。

examples.en: The housing office requires a surge protector for any appliance with a motor.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室要求带电机的电器必须接「浪涌保护插座」。

collocations: joule rating of a surge protector

words.enDefinition: a long flexible cord that brings power to distant spots

examples.en: We ran an extension cord behind the couch so both lamps reach the outlet.
examples.zh: 我们把「延长线」从沙发后面引过去，两盏台灯都够得到插座了。

examples.en: Never daisy-chain extension cords; the housing inspection sheet says so explicitly.
examples.zh: 「延长线」不能串联使用，宿舍检查表上写得明明白白。

words.enDefinition: a wall socket where plugs connect to electricity

examples.en: Every bunk in our dorm has one outlet, so we split it with a strip.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍每个床位只有一个「插座」，只好用插排分给两个人。

examples.en: The outlet behind the desk is loose, so report it to maintenance.
examples.zh: 书桌后面那个「插座」松了，报修给物业吧。

words.enDefinition: small cells that store energy to power devices

examples.en: The smoke detector chirped all night until we swapped the batteries.
examples.zh: 烟雾报警器叫了一整晚，直到我们换了「电池」。

examples.en: Keep spare batteries for your mouse in the desk organizer.
examples.zh: 在桌面收纳盒里给鼠标备几节「电池」。

words.enDefinition: a glass part that produces light inside a lamp

examples.en: The ceiling light flickered until we replaced the light bulb ourselves.
examples.zh: 吸顶灯一直闪，最后我们自己换了「灯泡」。

examples.en: Buy warm-white light bulbs for the desk lamp; bright ones strain your eyes.
examples.zh: 台灯买暖白「灯泡」，太亮的白光伤眼。

words.enDefinition: small cordless headphones worn inside each ear

examples.en: My wireless earbuds died right before my recorded lecture finished.
examples.zh: 录播课快听完时，我的「无线耳机」没电了。

examples.en: Keep wireless earbuds in their case so they charge between classes.
examples.zh: 「无线耳机」不用时放回充电盒，课间正好充电。

words.enDefinition: large headphones with cushions that cover both ears

examples.en: Over-ear headphones block dorm noise better than tiny earbuds do.
examples.zh: 「头戴式耳机」比小耳塞更能隔绝宿舍噪音。

examples.en: I bought over-ear headphones with a mic for online seminars.
examples.zh: 我买了带麦克风的「头戴式耳机」，上网课讨论用。

words.enDefinition: a computer mouse that connects without a cable

examples.en: A wireless mouse makes spreadsheet work much faster on my laptop.
examples.zh: 用「无线鼠标」在笔记本上做表格快多了。

examples.en: My wireless mouse runs on one AA battery that lasts months.
examples.zh: 我的「无线鼠标」一节五号电池能用几个月。

words.enDefinition: a flat mat that improves mouse tracking on a desk

examples.en: The desk has no mouse pad, so my cursor jumps around.
examples.zh: 这张桌子没有「鼠标垫」，光标总乱跳。

examples.en: I bought a wide mouse pad that fits both the keyboard and mouse.
examples.zh: 我买了块加大「鼠标垫」，键盘鼠标都放得下。

words.enDefinition: a support that raises a laptop to a comfortable angle

examples.en: A laptop stand raised my screen to eye level and saved my neck.
examples.zh: 「笔记本支架」把屏幕抬到视线高度，脖子舒服多了。

examples.en: My folding laptop stand fits flat at the bottom of my backpack.
examples.zh: 我的折叠「笔记本支架」能平放进背包底部。

words.enDefinition: a small portable device for storing and moving files

examples.en: Bring a flash drive to the print shop for large poster files.
examples.zh: 打印大海报要去图文店，记得带「U盘」。

examples.en: The lab computers block cloud drives, so use a flash drive instead.
examples.zh: 机房电脑不让用网盘，改用「U盘」吧。

collocations: copy files to a flash drive

words.enDefinition: a small lamp placed on a desk for focused light

examples.en: My clip-on desk lamp clamps to the bunk frame for late reading.
examples.zh: 我的夹式「台灯」夹在床架上，夜读方便。

examples.en: A warm desk lamp is kinder to roommates than overhead lights at midnight.
examples.zh: 半夜用暖光「台灯」，比开顶灯对室友友好。

words.enDefinition: A wedge set under a door to hold it in place.

examples.en: I slipped a door wedge under the kitchen door while carrying the groceries inside.
examples.zh: 我往厨房门下塞了一个「楔形门挡」，好把买来的食品搬进去。

examples.en: The door wedge kept the hallway door open long enough to bring in the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 「楔形门挡」让走廊那扇门一直开着，方便我们把书架搬进来。

collocations: slide a door wedge under the door

words.enDefinition: a handheld electric light powered by batteries

examples.en: Keep a flashlight by the door for dorm fire drills and blackouts.
examples.zh: 门口放个「手电筒」，消防演习和停电时用得上。

examples.en: We used a phone flashlight when the flashlight batteries died mid-hike.
examples.zh: 徒步途中「手电筒」没电了，只好开手机照明。

words.enDefinition: an insulated bottle that keeps drinks hot or cold

examples.en: My thermos keeps my soup hot through three back-to-back lectures.
examples.zh: 我的「保温杯」能让汤在三节连堂课里保持热度。

examples.en: Fill the thermos before morning labs; the water fountain is far away.
examples.zh: 早上实验课前把「保温壶」灌满，饮水机离得远。

words.enDefinition: a bottle used for carrying drinking water

examples.en: Refill your water bottle at the gym fountain after practice.
examples.zh: 训练结束，去健身房饮水机把「水瓶」灌满。

examples.en: A dented aluminum water bottle survived being dropped down the stairs.
examples.zh: 我的铝制「水瓶」摔下楼梯也只凹了个小坑。

words.enDefinition: a sealed insulated cup for hot drinks on the go

examples.en: Most campus cafés discount refills if you bring a travel mug.
examples.zh: 自带「随行咖啡杯」的话，校园咖啡馆续杯有折扣。

examples.en: The travel mug's lid locks, so it survives a bag full of textbooks.
examples.zh: 「随行咖啡杯」的盖子能锁紧，扔进课本堆里也不漏。

collocations: travel mug with a lockable lid

words.enDefinition: a cylindrical cup with a handle for hot drinks

examples.en: My roommate's mug collection fills half the shared drying rack.
examples.zh: 室友的「马克杯」占了公用沥水架的一半。

examples.en: There's a chipped mug in the cupboard that everyone secretly avoids.
examples.zh: 橱柜里有个缺口的「马克杯」，大家都不碰。

words.enDefinition: a container used to carry meals from home

examples.en: My bento-style lunch box has compartments that keep rice and toppings apart.
examples.zh: 我的日式「饭盒」有分格，米饭和菜不串味。

examples.en: Microwave-safe lunch boxes are essential for the dorm common room.
examples.zh: 宿舍公共活动室里，可微波的「饭盒」必不可少。

words.enDefinition: a lidded box for storing leftovers or packed food

examples.en: Label your food container with your name before it enters the shared fridge.
examples.zh: 「保鲜盒」放进公用冰箱前，先贴上名字。

examples.en: A leak-proof food container saved my backpack from soup disaster.
examples.zh: 一个防漏「保鲜盒」让我的背包躲过了汤水劫。

words.enDefinition: a plastic bag that seals by pressing its edges together

examples.en: Pack wet swimwear in a ziplock bag before it goes into your duffel.
examples.zh: 湿泳衣先用「密封袋」装好，再放进旅行包。

examples.en: Portion trail mix into ziplock bags for long library study days.
examples.zh: 长时间泡图书馆，把坚果干果分装进「密封袋」。

words.enDefinition: thin metal paper used to wrap and cover food

examples.en: Cover the leftovers with aluminum foil before reheating them in the shared oven.
examples.zh: 剩菜盖上「锡纸」，再放进公用烤箱加热。

examples.en: A sheet of aluminum foil under the pan saves the baking tray.
examples.zh: 烤盘上垫一张「锡纸」，洗起来省事多了。

words.enDefinition: a clear clingy film that covers food and bowls

examples.en: Stretch plastic wrap over the bowl so the fridge smells stay contained.
examples.zh: 碗口蒙上「保鲜膜」，冰箱里就不串味。

examples.en: The dorm keeps plastic wrap and foil by the microwave for shared use.
examples.zh: 宿舍把「保鲜膜」和锡纸放在微波炉旁，供大家取用。

words.enDefinition: a disposable paper sheet for wiping and cleaning

examples.en: Blot the spilled noodles with a paper towel before they stain the carpet.
examples.zh: 泡面洒了先用「厨房纸」吸掉，免得弄脏地毯。

examples.en: The kitchen roll holder ran empty, so grab paper towels from the storage closet.
examples.zh: 厨房纸架空了，去储物间再拿些「厨房纸巾」。

words.enDefinition: a small paper or cloth square for wiping your mouth

examples.en: Grab a stack of napkins when you pick up the pizza order.
examples.zh: 去取披萨时，顺手多拿几沓「餐巾纸」。

examples.en: Dining hall dispensers give one napkin per pull, so plan ahead.
examples.zh: 食堂「餐巾纸」机一次只出一张，要提前多抽。

words.enDefinition: a pair of slender sticks used to pick up food

examples.en: The dining hall keeps disposable chopsticks by the noodle station.
examples.zh: 食堂在面档旁边放着一次性「筷子」。

examples.en: I carry my own chopsticks so I skip the plastic ones.
examples.zh: 我自带「筷子」，就不用一次性塑料的了。

words.enDefinition: an open basket for carrying clothes to wash

examples.en: Carry your laundry basket to the basement machines on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 周日早上把「洗衣篮」搬到地下室洗衣房。

examples.en: A flexible laundry basket squishes flat when it is empty.
examples.zh: 软质「洗衣篮」空了可以压扁收纳。

collocations: line the laundry basket with a bag

words.enDefinition: a closed container where dirty clothes collect before washing

examples.en: A lidded laundry hamper hides the smell of post-gym clothes.
examples.zh: 带盖「脏衣篓」能盖住健身后衣服的味道。

examples.en: Sort colors straight into the laundry hamper to save time later.
examples.zh: 衣服脱下来直接按深浅色丢进「脏衣篓」，后面省事。

words.enDefinition: a liquid or powder product for washing clothes

examples.en: The campus store sells laundry detergent in small pods for one load.
examples.zh: 校内超市卖小包「洗衣液」，一次一缸正好。

examples.en: Too much laundry detergent leaves residue that itches sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 「洗衣液」放太多会残留，敏感肌穿了痒。

words.enDefinition: a fragrant sheet tossed in the dryer to soften clothes

examples.en: Toss one dryer sheet in with the towels to cut static.
examples.zh: 烘毛巾时丢一张「烘干纸」，能少很多静电。

examples.en: A dryer sheet tucked in the suitcase keeps clothes smelling fresh.
examples.zh: 行李箱里塞一张「烘干香纸」，衣服香香的。

words.enDefinition: a liquid added to laundry to make clothes soft

examples.en: Pour fabric softener into the marked dispenser, never onto the clothes.
examples.zh: 「衣物柔顺剂」要倒进指定投放口，别直接浇衣服上。

examples.en: Skip fabric softener on sportswear; it ruins the sweat-wicking coating.
examples.zh: 运动服别用「柔顺剂」，会毁掉吸汗涂层。

words.enDefinition: a small clip that holds clothes on a drying line

examples.en: Old-fashioned clothespins hold socks on the drying rack near the window.
examples.zh: 老式「晾衣夹」把袜子固定在窗边晾衣架上。

examples.en: Clip the chip bag with a clothespin when you lose the binder clip.
examples.zh: 找不到长尾夹，就用「晾衣夹」夹薯片袋口。

words.enDefinition: a frame where wet clothes hang to air dry

examples.en: Delicates go flat on the drying rack instead of the machine.
examples.zh: 贴身衣物平铺在「晾衣架」上，别丢进机器。

examples.en: Our drying rack by the radiator dries sweaters overnight in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天暖气旁的「晾衣架」，毛衣一晚就干。

collocations: lay flat on the drying rack

words.enDefinition: a sticky roll that removes lint and hair from clothes

examples.en: A lint roller rescues black clothes covered in cat hair from a visit home.
examples.zh: 从有猫的家里回来，衣服全是毛，全靠「粘毛器」。

examples.en: Keep a travel lint roller in your bag for interview outfits.
examples.zh: 包里放个便携「粘毛滚」，面试正装用得上。

words.enDefinition: a long-handled brush for sweeping floors

examples.en: The hallway broom is missing, so crumbs migrate toward my room.
examples.zh: 走廊的「扫帚」不见了，碎屑全往我房间跑。

examples.en: Sweep weekly with the broom; dust builds up fast near the vent.
examples.zh: 每周用「扫帚」扫一次，出风口附近特别容易积灰。

words.enDefinition: a small pan that collects swept dust and dirt

examples.en: A long-handled dustpan saves your back during finals week deep cleaning.
examples.zh: 长柄「簸箕」让期末大扫除不用弯腰。

examples.en: Sweep the glass shards toward the dustpan carefully, not with your hands.
examples.zh: 碎玻璃小心扫向「簸箕」，千万别用手捡。

words.enDefinition: a cleaning tool with an absorbent head for floors

examples.en: Run the mop over the kitchen floor after every stir-fry session.
examples.zh: 每次炒完菜，都用「拖把」拖一遍厨房。

examples.en: The spray mop came with refillable bottles and two washable pads.
examples.zh: 这把喷雾「拖把」带可灌装瓶和两块可洗拖布。

words.enDefinition: an electric machine that sucks dust off floors and rugs

examples.en: Borrow the dorm's shared vacuum for the rug before room inspection.
examples.zh: 宿舍检查前，借公用「吸尘器」清理地毯。

examples.en: A cordless vacuum charges on the wall bracket and grabs cereal fast.
examples.zh: 无线「吸尘器」挂在墙上充电，撒了麦片很快吸净。

words.enDefinition: a container for throwing away waste

examples.en: Line the trash can with two bags so leaks never reach the bin.
examples.zh: 「垃圾桶」套两层袋子，漏液就弄不脏桶身。

examples.en: The shared trash can fills fast during finals; empty it daily.
examples.zh: 期末公用「垃圾桶」满得快，每天都要清。

words.enDefinition: a plastic bag that lines a trash can

examples.en: Tie the trash bag before hauling it to the chute on our floor.
examples.zh: 把「垃圾袋」系紧，再拿到本楼层垃圾道扔。

examples.en: Buy tall-kitchen trash bags; the wrong size slips into the can.
examples.zh: 买大号厨房「垃圾袋」，尺寸不对会滑进桶里。

words.enDefinition: a soft porous block for washing dishes or wiping surfaces

examples.en: Replace the kitchen sponge every two weeks; bacteria love damp foam.
examples.zh: 「海绵擦」两周一换，细菌最爱湿海绵。

examples.en: The scratch-free sponge handles nonstick pans without ruining the coating.
examples.zh: 不划涂层的「海绵」专门洗不粘锅。

words.enDefinition: a small brush used to clean teeth

examples.en: Replace your toothbrush after recovering from a cold, dentists say.
examples.zh: 牙医说，感冒好了要换「牙刷」。

examples.en: Pack a travel toothbrush in your carry-on for long flights.
examples.zh: 长途航班随身行李里放一支旅行「牙刷」。

words.enDefinition: a paste used with a toothbrush to clean teeth

examples.en: A travel-size toothpaste tube clears airport security without any fuss.
examples.zh: 旅行装「牙膏」过安检毫不费事。

examples.en: We split a big tube of toothpaste between three roommates to save money.
examples.zh: 三个室友分一大管「牙膏」，省钱。

words.enDefinition: thin thread used to clean between teeth

examples.en: Keep dental floss in your backpack; cafeteria popcorn is a trap.
examples.zh: 背包里常备「牙线」，食堂爆米花是陷阱。

examples.en: The dentist reminded me that dental floss matters more than mouthwash.
examples.zh: 牙医提醒我，「牙线」比漱口水更重要。

words.enDefinition: a bladed tool used to shave body hair

examples.en: Store your razor outside the shower to keep the blades from rusting.
examples.zh: 「剃须刀」别放在淋浴间，刀片容易锈。

examples.en: The pharmacy sells razors in multipacks that last a whole semester.
examples.zh: 药店的多支装「剃须刀」够用一学期。

words.enDefinition: a soap product for washing hair

examples.en: The dorm shower caddy holds everyone's shampoo bottles side by side.
examples.zh: 宿舍浴室置物架上，大家的「洗发水」并排站着。

examples.en: Solid shampoo bars last longer than liquid bottles in hard-water cities.
examples.zh: 水质硬的城市里，「固体洗发皂」比瓶装洗发水耐用。

words.enDefinition: a hair product that softens hair after shampooing

examples.en: Run conditioner through the ends only, not the roots, to avoid greasy hair.
examples.zh: 「护发素」只涂发梢别碰发根，不然头发容易油。

examples.en: The travel conditioner bottle leaked all over my toiletry bag.
examples.zh: 旅行装「护发素」漏得我洗漱包到处都是。

words.enDefinition: a cream product that moisturizes skin

examples.en: Winter dorm heating dries skin fast, so keep lotion by your bed.
examples.zh: 冬天宿舍暖气很干，「润肤乳」就放床边。

examples.en: This unscented lotion works on both hands and face before class.
examples.zh: 这款无香「润肤乳」上课前涂手涂脸都行。

words.enDefinition: a product applied under the arms to stop odor

examples.en: Gym-goers keep a spare deodorant stick in their locker for post-workout.
examples.zh: 常去健身房的人，储物柜里都备一支「除臭剂」。

examples.en: Solid deodorant survives flights better than aerosol sprays in carry-ons.
examples.zh: 「除臭剂」固体款比喷雾更适合随身登机。

words.enDefinition: a waxy product that moisturizes dry lips

examples.en: Wind across the quad chaps lips, so carry lip balm in winter.
examples.zh: 校园风大嘴唇容易裂，冬天随身带「润唇膏」。

examples.en: My lip balm melted inside the car during the road trip.
examples.zh: 自驾游路上，「润唇膏」在车里化掉了。

words.enDefinition: a gel that cleans hands without water

examples.en: The lecture hall installed hand sanitizer dispensers by every entrance.
examples.zh: 阶梯教室每个入口都装了「免洗洗手液」出液器。

examples.en: Alcohol-based hand sanitizer dries my skin, so I follow it with cream.
examples.zh: 酒精「免洗洗手液」拔干，用完得抹护手霜。

words.enDefinition: a small tool for trimming fingernails

examples.en: Borrow nail clippers from the RA desk instead of biting your nails.
examples.zh: 别啃指甲了，去宿管值班台借「指甲刀」。

examples.en: The grooming kit includes nail clippers, a small file, and tweezers.
examples.zh: 这套修容工具有「指甲刀」、小锉刀和镊子。

words.enDefinition: an electric device that blows hot air to dry hair

examples.en: The communal bathroom's hair dryer is first-come, first-served after 8 a.m.
examples.zh: 公共浴室的「吹风机」，八点后先到先用。

examples.en: My compact hair dryer folds in half to fit the suitcase pocket.
examples.zh: 我的便携「吹风机」能对折，塞进行李箱口袋正好。

words.enDefinition: a soft cushion that supports the head while sleeping

examples.en: Dorm mattresses are firm, so I brought an extra pillow for reading in bed.
examples.zh: 宿舍床垫偏硬，我多带了个「枕头」靠床上看书。

examples.en: Fluff your pillow nightly or it flattens into a pancake.
examples.zh: 「枕头」每晚拍松，不然会扁成一块饼。

words.enDefinition: a cloth covering laid over a mattress

examples.en: Buy extra-long twin bed sheets; dorm mattresses run longer than regular ones.
examples.zh: 买加长单人「床单」，宿舍床垫比普通的长。

examples.en: Wash bed sheets every two weeks to keep allergies under control.
examples.zh: 「床单」两周洗一次，过敏才不会加重。

words.enDefinition: a thick soft quilt filled with down or fibers

examples.en: Shake the duvet every morning so the filling spreads evenly again.
examples.zh: 每天早上抖抖「被子」，填充物才回弹均匀。

examples.en: An all-season duvet works from September right through spring finals.
examples.zh: 一床四季「被芯」从九月盖到春季期末。

collocations: stuff the duvet into its cover

words.enDefinition: a washable fabric shell that encloses a duvet

examples.en: A duvet cover means you wash the cover, never the duvet itself.
examples.zh: 有了「被套」，要洗的只是套，被芯不用动。

examples.en: Zip the duvet cover closed so the insert stays put overnight.
examples.zh: 「被套」拉链拉好，被芯整晚不乱跑。

words.enDefinition: a thin padded layer placed over a mattress

examples.en: A quilted mattress pad softens the rock-hard dorm mattress instantly.
examples.zh: 绗缝「床垫软垫」立刻让硬床垫变舒服。

examples.en: Waterproof mattress pads protect against spilled tea and midnight accidents.
examples.zh: 防水「床垫保护垫」能挡住打翻的茶水。

words.enDefinition: a soft band worn over the eyes to block light

examples.en: A contoured eye mask blocks the hallway light that leaks under the door.
examples.zh: 立体「眼罩」能挡住门缝漏进来的走廊灯。

examples.en: I pack my eye mask for red-eye flights and hostel stays.
examples.zh: 坐红眼航班或住青旅，我都带「眼罩」。

words.enDefinition: small foam plugs worn in ears to block noise

examples.en: Foam earplugs save sleep during finals week when the hall stays loud.
examples.zh: 期末周楼道很吵，泡沫「耳塞」保住了睡眠。

examples.en: Squeeze the earplugs small before they expand to seal your ears.
examples.zh: 「耳塞」先捏细再放，回弹膨胀才堵得住耳朵。

words.enDefinition: a machine that adds moisture to dry indoor air

examples.en: The mini humidifier runs beside my bed all winter for dry sinuses.
examples.zh: 冬天床头的小「加湿器」一直开着，缓解鼻腔干燥。

examples.en: Clean the humidifier weekly or the tank turns pink with mold.
examples.zh: 「加湿器」每周清洗，不然水箱长粉色霉。

words.enDefinition: a portable device that warms a single room

examples.en: Check the housing rules before buying a space heater for your room.
examples.zh: 给房间买「电暖器」前，先查住宿规定。

examples.en: Our space heater trips the breaker if the fridge runs at the same time.
examples.zh: 小冰箱同时开，我们的「暖风机」会跳闸。

collocations: tip-over protection on a space heater

words.enDefinition: soft light shoes worn indoors

examples.en: Communal bathrooms at 3 a.m. are survivable with warm slippers.
examples.zh: 凌晨三点去公共浴室，有双保暖「拖鞋」好熬多了。

examples.en: The host insisted we swap sneakers for house slippers at the door.
examples.zh: 主人坚持让我们进门就把运动鞋换成室内「拖鞋」。

words.enDefinition: a waterproof coat worn in rain

examples.en: A packable raincoat lives in my backpack from October to April.
examples.zh: 从十月到四月，背包里一直备着可收纳的「雨衣」。

examples.en: The raincoat hood fits over a beanie without blowing off.
examples.zh: 「雨衣」帽子罩得住毛线帽，风吹不掉。

words.enDefinition: waterproof rubber boots worn in wet weather

examples.en: Rain boots are essential for the puddle maze between lecture halls.
examples.zh: 教学楼之间全是水坑，没「雨靴」真不行。

examples.en: My short rain boots slip into a tote bag after the storm passes.
examples.zh: 暴雨过后，短筒「雨靴」能塞进托特包里。

words.enDefinition: a close-fitting knitted cap without a brim

examples.en: My campus beanie survived four winters and still holds its shape.
examples.zh: 我的校园款「毛线帽」戴了四个冬天还没变形。

examples.en: Tuck the beanie over your ears; the wind cuts right through.
examples.zh: 把「毛线帽」拉低盖住耳朵，风直灌。

words.enDefinition: hand coverings with separate fingers for warmth

examples.en: I keep touchscreen gloves for walking to morning lectures in January.
examples.zh: 一月早课路上，全靠触屏「手套」边走边回消息。

examples.en: Wool gloves shrink if you toss them in the dryer by mistake.
examples.zh: 「手套」误进烘干机，羊毛款会缩水。

words.enDefinition: a long fabric wrap worn around the neck

examples.en: Wrap the scarf twice around your neck; the lake wind is brutal.
examples.zh: 「围巾」在脖子上绕两圈，湖边的风太狠了。

examples.en: My professor knits a wool scarf for her students every December.
examples.zh: 每年十二月，教授都给学生织羊毛「围巾」。

words.enDefinition: dark glasses that protect eyes from sunlight

examples.en: Keep sunglasses in your bag for the walk across the main quad.
examples.zh: 去主草坪的路上阳光毒，包里备好「太阳镜」。

examples.en: These sunglasses are polarized, so the lake glare doesn't blind me.
examples.zh: 这副「太阳镜」是偏光的，湖面反光不晃眼。

words.enDefinition: a small folding umbrella that fits in a bag

examples.en: A travel umbrella in your bag beats sprinting between buildings in storms.
examples.zh: 暴雨里与其在楼间狂奔，不如包里备把「折叠伞」。

examples.en: My travel umbrella flipped inside out twice on the exposed bridge.
examples.zh: 没遮挡的大桥上，我的「折叠伞」翻了两次。

words.enDefinition: a ring or charm that holds keys together

examples.en: My dorm keychain has a mini bottle opener and a bell.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍「钥匙扣」上挂着迷你开瓶器和小铃铛。

examples.en: Attach your keys to a bright keychain so they never vanish in your bag.
examples.zh: 钥匙挂上显眼的「钥匙扣」，就不会在包里失踪。

words.enDefinition: a strap worn around the neck to hold an ID card

examples.en: Wear your student ID on a lanyard so it's visible at every gate.
examples.zh: 学生证挂在「挂绳」上，过每个闸机都看得清。

examples.en: The orientation lanyard color shows which campus tour group you joined.
examples.zh: 迎新「挂绳」的颜色代表你所在的参观小组。

collocations: clip the badge onto a lanyard

words.enDefinition: a plastic sleeve that protects and displays an ID card

examples.en: A retractable badge holder stretches to swipe into the lab door.
examples.zh: 伸缩「证件卡套」一拉就能刷开实验室的门。

examples.en: Swap your clear badge holder each semester when the ID photo changes.
examples.zh: 每学期证件照更新，就换个新的透明「卡套」。

collocations: insert the card into the badge holder

words.enDefinition: a slim wallet for carrying bank and campus cards

examples.en: My slim card holder carries the campus ID, bank card, and transit pass.
examples.zh: 我的薄「卡包」装着校园卡、银行卡和交通卡。

examples.en: A zippered card holder is safer than a bulging wallet at festivals.
examples.zh: 参加活动时，拉链「卡包」比鼓钱包安全。

collocations: organize cards in a card holder

words.enDefinition: a hard protective box for storing eyeglasses

examples.en: A hard glasses case survives being crushed by textbooks in a backpack.
examples.zh: 硬壳「眼镜盒」被课本挤压也不怕。

examples.en: Clip the glasses case to your belt loop during lab work.
examples.zh: 做实验时，把「眼镜盒」扣在裤腰带上。

words.enDefinition: a detachable lock with a shackle for lockers and doors

examples.en: Gym lockers need a padlock; the front desk sells combination ones.
examples.zh: 健身房储物柜要用「挂锁」，前台卖密码款。

examples.en: Buy a weatherproof padlock for the bike cage behind the dorm.
examples.zh: 给宿舍后面的自行车棚配把防水「挂锁」。

words.enDefinition: a lock opened by dialing the correct number sequence

examples.en: Set your own code when the combination lock arrives from the bookstore.
examples.zh: 书店买的「密码锁」到手先设好密码。

examples.en: I forgot my combination lock code and missed my own lab session.
examples.zh: 我忘了「密码锁」密码，差点误了实验课。

words.enDefinition: a chain or shackle lock that secures a bicycle

examples.en: Thread the bike lock through the frame and wheel, not just the wheel.
examples.zh: 「车锁」要穿过车架和轮子，不能只锁轮子。

examples.en: Campus security recommends a U-lock style bike lock over thin cables.
examples.zh: 校园保安建议用U型「车锁」，别用细钢缆。

words.enDefinition: a pin with a protective clasp over its sharp point

examples.en: A safety pin closed the gap in my blazer minutes before the presentation.
examples.zh: 演讲前几分钟，一枚「安全别针」别住了外套开缝。

examples.en: Keep safety pins in your sewing kit for loose buttons and hems.
examples.zh: 针线包里备几枚「安全别针」，纽扣松了能应急。

words.enDefinition: adhesive strips that hang items without damaging walls

examples.en: Use command strips to hang posters without losing your housing deposit.
examples.zh: 用「无痕挂钩贴」贴海报，不会损失租房押金。

examples.en: These command strips peel off cleanly when you move out in May.
examples.zh: 五月搬走时，这些「无痕贴」能干净撕下。

words.enDefinition: sticky wall hooks for hanging towels and bags

examples.en: Two adhesive hooks behind the door hold my bathrobe and tote bag.
examples.zh: 门后两个「粘钩」挂着我的浴袍和托特包。

examples.en: Weight limits matter; overloaded adhesive hooks peel off the wall overnight.
examples.zh: 「粘钩」要注意承重，超重一夜就脱落。

words.enDefinition: a paper wrapper for mailing letters and documents

examples.en: Seal the envelope properly or the financial aid office rejects your form.
examples.zh: 「信封」要封好，否则资助办公室会退表。

examples.en: Address the envelope in block letters so the sorter reads it correctly.
examples.zh: 「信封」地址用大写正体写，分拣机才读得清。

words.enDefinition: a fare card used to ride city public transit

examples.en: Tap your metro card on the reader before the turnstile light turns red.
examples.zh: 闸机灯变红前，把「地铁卡」贴到读卡区。

examples.en: Student metro cards cost half fare once the university verifies enrollment.
examples.zh: 学校核实注册后，学生「地铁卡」能半价。

words.enDefinition: a prepaid card redeemable at a specific store

examples.en: A bookstore gift card makes a safe birthday present for any classmate.
examples.zh: 送同学生日礼物，书店「礼品卡」最保险。

examples.en: She redeemed her coffee gift card gradually across final exam weeks.
examples.zh: 期末那几周，她一点点用完了咖啡「礼品卡」。
